dct_description_sm:
Shore access points are areas where access to the shore is available by stairways or pathways.  These shore access points are used in our Emergency Services mapping, and are updated manually as needed.

Note: Attributes represent each field in a dataset, and some fields will contain information such as ID numbers.  As a result some visualizations on the tabs on our Open Data page will not be relevant.
